newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ever climbs to 1.10 pesos by midsession.
newsitem.headline: Ever climbs to 1.10 pesos by midsession.

text.p: Shopping mall operator Ever-Gotesco Resources and Holdings Inc climbed to 1.10 pesos by midsession on its debut on Monday on the Philippine Stock Exchange in heavy turnover, brokers said.
Erwin Tan of Abacus Securities said local investors were buying up the issue, hoping it would rise to 1.20 pesos.
"The buying is purely speculative," he said.
The issue earlier rose to 1.12 pesos but quickly succumbed to profit-taking. The issue price was one peso.
Midsession turnover was just under 200 million pesos.
